# Style Guide

## Tone Profile

- Baseline tone: premium, calm, and direct.
- Emotional register: supportive, never dramatic.
- Confidence style: assured but measured.
- Default language: English only.
- Marketing surfaces: slightly more expressive, still restrained.
- Authenticated surfaces: more functional, more minimal, more utility-first.

## Sentence and Structure Rules

- Keep average sentence length short.
- Use active voice in most lines.
- Limit each paragraph to one idea.
- Avoid stacked clauses and long qualifier chains.
- Use headings that preview value, not hype.

## Vocabulary Rules

Prefer:

- "clear"
- "focused"
- "supported"
- "structured"
- "trusted"
- "ready"
- "simple"
- "quiet"
- "direct"

Avoid:

- "revolutionary"
- "unbeatable"
- "guaranteed"
- "instant"
- "world-class" (unless proven with named evidence)
- "seamless" when it hides real complexity
- "delightful" when used as filler

## Clarity Moves

- Replace abstract nouns with concrete actions.
- Replace generic promises with process details.
- Replace broad claims with realistic outcomes.
- Remove duplicate points across adjacent lines.

## Before and After Pattern

Before:
"We deliver world-class immigration solutions with guaranteed success and unmatched speed."

After:
"We provide structured immigration support, from document preparation to submission guidance. Processing times depend on case details and government timelines."

## CTA Guidance

- Keep CTA verbs specific: "Book a consultation", "Start your profile", "Share your CV".
- Use one primary CTA per block.
- Keep CTA friction low and explicit.
- On admin pages, prefer plain action language: "Save changes", "Invite user", "Create project", "Review application".

## Product UI Guidance

- Titles should describe the screen or task immediately.
- Helper text should answer one question at a time.
- Empty states should explain what is missing and what action unlocks progress.
- Error states should avoid blame and focus on recovery.

## Final Quality Gate

Ship only when copy is:

- Easy to understand on first read.
- Free of legal-risk claims.
- Consistent with elegant, human, trustworthy tone.
